records.title: Resource-Aware Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Local Small Language Models
records.reason: The call-count reduction may lower local inference cost in constrained logical tasks, but scope is narrow and the paper does not establish general serving efficiency.

records.title: DnA: Denoising Attention for Visual Tasks
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: The softmax activation in multihead attention (MHA) is the de facto standard for attention-based models in visual perception tasks. However, standard softmax can produce noisy attention patterns that dilute relevant features and degrade its performance. In this paper, we propose Denoising Attention or DnA, in which, first, a positive query identifies which image features belong to the correct class, and a negative qu… Out of scope: Visual perception attention for accuracy, no runtime efficiency contribution.

records.title: Prism Transformer: Progressive Head Schedules for Hierarchical Attention Processing
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Multi-head attention conventionally partitions the hidden dimension equally across all heads at every layer, enforcing an identical representational subspace dimension (dh = dmodel/h) throughout the models depth. In this work, we identify this uniform allocation as a fundamental structural bottleneck: due to their restricted dimensional space, early-layer heads are unable to faithfully capture complex, high-dimension… Out of scope: Compute-neutral architecture explicitly has no inference overhead change.

records.title: Speculative Refinement: A Hybrid Autoregressive Diffusion Decoding Strategy and Its Behavior Across Benchmarks
records.reason: There are direct latency results for a decoding technique, but the paper is mainly an evaluation-method study and performance is strongly step/task dependent with limited setup.

records.title: The Context-Ready Transformer
records.reason: The paper reports direct inference speedups, but evidence is limited to small configurations and two datasets, with no production serving or released implementation evidence.
